title: No-Show Basis by Funding of the Appointment Series
content:
Decision table — the no-show basis of an Appointment Series no-show fee follows the funding of the series.

**Rule.** Where the series is funded by an Insured Plan of Care whose verified copay is above zero, the no-show basis is the lesser of the no-show fee of the series' format and that copay; where the series is funded by a Self-Pay Visit Package whose package tier lists a single-visit cash rate above zero, the no-show basis is 50 percent of that single-visit cash rate; for any other series the no-show basis is the no-show fee of the series' format.

| Funding source on the series record | Condition on the funding record | No-show basis |
|---|---|---|
| Insured Plan of Care | verified copay above zero | the lesser of the format's no-show fee and the verified copay |
| Self-Pay Visit Package | package tier lists a single-visit cash rate above zero | 50 percent of the single-visit cash rate |
| any other funding, or the condition above not met | — | the format's no-show fee |

**Cases (hypothetical figures; format no-show fee USD 50.00).**

- Insured Plan of Care with a verified copay of USD 40.00: the no-show basis is USD 40.00.
- Insured Plan of Care with a verified copay of USD 75.00: the no-show basis is USD 50.00.
- Self-Pay Visit Package whose tier cash rate is USD 125.00: the no-show basis is USD 62.50.
- Workers' Compensation Referral: the no-show basis is USD 50.00.
